attacks.name: Strike
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.

attacks.name: Energy Blast
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains 1 |!power|.

attacks.name: Rocket Punch
steps: |!wild| |*Stagger|: After this attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§stagger§Stagger| special condition.

superPowers.name: Binary Form
superPowers.body: |<binary_form>Until the start of this character's next activation|, it adds two dice to its attack and defense rolls.

superPowers.name: Danvers‘ Special
superPowers.body: Choose an interactive terrain feature or an enemy character, both of Size 4 or less and within |!range| 2, and throw it |!range_medium|. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Energy Absorption
superPowers.body: When this character is defending against an |!energy| attack, for each |!wild| in the defense roll they may change one of the attacker's |!critical|, |!wild|, or |!hit| results to a blank. This character gains 1 |!power| for each die changed in this way.
